packages.title: Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, Live TV, Trakt, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Live TV: Channels and sports from your live addons, with Favorites and Recent.
Trakt: What you watch tracked, watched marks, Continue Watching and Trakt rows on Home. Bring your own Client ID.
Seek previews: A picture of the film on the seek bar as you move through it, for debrid and direct links.
Chapters: The film's chapters on the seek bar and in the seek pill. Settings › Seek bar.
Tracks per show: The subtitles and audio you pick stay for the whole show.
